### GrabAGun Appoints W. Bryan Hill to Board of Directors


November 12, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/956379955/files/doc_news/GrabAGun-Appoints-W--Bryan-Hill-to-Board-of-Directors-2026.pdf)


**Veteran public-company executive brings extensive experience in financial leadership, capital markets and strategic growth**


COPPELL, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


GrabAGun Digital Holdings Inc. (“GrabAGun” or the “Company”) (NYSE: PEW), a technology-driven commerce and platform company serving the firearms, ammunition and outdoor industry, today announced the appointment of W. Bryan Hill to its Board of Directors, effective November 9, 2026. Mr. Hill’s appointment further strengthens the Board’s public-company, financial and strategic expertise.


Mr. Hill will serve on the Audit and M&A Committees. The Board has determined that he is independent under New York Stock Exchange listing standards.


“Bryan’s public-company leadership, financial discipline and strategic experience further strengthen our Board,” said Marc Nemati, President and Chief Executive Officer of GrabAGun. “His background in scaling technology businesses, capital allocation and financial oversight will be valuable as we advance our commerce and platform strategy.”


Mr. Hill has more than three decades of finance and business leadership experience. He served as Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer of Alkami Technology, a digital banking software solutions company, from 2019 to 2025, helping prepare the company for its 2021 IPO. Previously, he held the CFO role at RealPage, a property management software company, from 2014 to 2019. His experience spans public offerings, financing transactions and mergers and acquisitions. Earlier, he held senior finance roles at DynCorp International and SourceCorp.


Mr. Hill currently serves on EquipmentShare.com Inc.’s board, chairing its Audit Committee and serving on its Compensation Committee. He holds a BBA from Texas Christian University and is a Texas CPA.


“GrabAGun’s technology-driven approach to commerce and platform services is compelling,” said Mr. Hill. “I look forward to working with the Board and management team to support disciplined growth and long-term shareholder value.”


**About GrabAGun Digital Holdings Inc.**


GrabAGun Digital Holdings Inc. (NYSE: PEW) is a technology-driven commerce, distribution, and logistics company serving the firearms, ammunition, and outdoor industry. The Company operates across three complementary capabilities: digital retail through[GrabAGun.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2FGrabAGun.com&esheet=54640580&newsitemid=20261112352719&lan=en-US&anchor=GrabAGun.com&index=1&md5=4722877fc1b0394e99595fec6dfc6393) , operated by its wholly-owned subsidiary GrabAGun LLC; wholesale distribution through its wholly-owned subsidiary Camfour LLC; and manufacturer logistics and platform services through its wholly-owned subsidiary PEW Logistics LLC. GrabAGun.com is one of the nation’s leading online firearms retailers, built on 16 years of proprietary technology spanning inventory and order management, pricing, demand forecasting, and regulatory compliance. PEW Logistics provides manufacturers with technology-enabled fulfillment, compliance, data, marketing, and direct-to-consumer capabilities. Together with Camfour, these separately operated businesses connect manufacturers, independent dealers, and consumers, with a goal of improving product access, distribution efficiency, and industry connectivity. For more information, visit[investors.grabagun.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Finvestors.grabagun.com&esheet=54640580&newsitemid=20261112352719&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.grabagun.com&index=2&md5=9063e403ad2deda3461506ffec197622) .
